name: house_police
prompt: Keep exactly the same pink house, street and composition. Now strong red and blue police lights reflect on the wet road and on the house walls, police cars parked far down the street. No people.

name: house_dawn
prompt: Keep exactly the same pink house and street composition, but at dawn: warm golden sunrise light, the rain has stopped, mist lifting from the lawn, no police tape, no police cars, calm and hopeful.

name: house_return
prompt: Keep exactly the same pink house at night. Add the small dark silhouette of a slender young woman in a knitted beanie walking slowly back toward the front door, seen from behind, face never visible.

name: cage_open
prompt: Keep exactly the same birdcage, table and lighting, but the small cage door is now wide open, and a small dark bird still sits motionless inside the cage.

name: screen_off
prompt: Keep exactly the same room and composition, but the computer monitor is now switched off and black, the room is much darker, only faint moonlight.

name: night_street_gypsy
prompt: An empty suburban street at night under one street lamp. The silhouette of a slender young woman in a knitted beanie walks away from the camera, seen from behind, face hidden, wet asphalt, mist.

name: fog_deedee
prompt: Thick fog in a dark empty space. The dark silhouette of a heavy-set middle-aged woman in a floral dress stands beside an empty wheelchair, her face completely in shadow with no features, faint pale rim light, faded and lonely.

name: spotlight_deedee
prompt: A dark theater stage. A single bright spotlight falls on the dark silhouette of a heavy-set middle-aged woman in a floral dress, one hand on the handle of an empty wheelchair, face completely in shadow with no features, as if on stage being admired.

name: glass_box_gypsy
prompt: A large glass box in the middle of a dark room. Inside it, the small silhouette of a slender young woman in a wheelchair wearing a knitted beanie, seen from behind, face hidden. Cold light on the glass, isolation.

name: crowd_away
prompt: An empty night street. A group of six dark human silhouettes stands with their backs turned to the camera, facing away, under a dim street lamp, faces never visible, cold indifference.

name: two_shadows
prompt: Two dark human silhouettes, a young man in a hoodie and a slender young woman, stand apart facing each other in a dark room; their long shadows on the wall merge into a single shape. Faces hidden, cold blue screen light, unsettling.
